subtitle: When Delhi Fell Silent, Mandu Found Its Voice

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of Mandu’s cliff edge at dusk
panels.action: Dilavar Khan Ghuri stands in silhouette on the sheer edge of the Mandu plateau, cloak stirred by the evening wind, looking down over forests and distant plains that fade into the violet sky.

dialogue.text: In the years after Timur’s sack of Delhi, as the old capital lay broken, Dilavar Khan Ghuri turned his face to Mandu and quietly made Malwa a kingdom in all but name.

i18n.hi: तैमूर की दिल्ली लूट के बाद, जब पुरानी राजधानी बिखर गई, दिलावर ख़ान ग़ूरी मानडू की ओर मुड़ा और चुपचाप मलवा को नाम के बग़ैर ही अपना राज्य बना दिया।

panels.shot: wide aerial over Delhi’s ruined quarters, smoky, desolate
panels.action: The image shows a devastated late-14th-century Delhi: roofless halls, scorched neighborhoods, abandoned streets; thin columns of smoke rise in the cold air over a once-grand city.

dialogue.text: In 1398, Timur’s army fell upon Delhi. Chronicles remember streets emptied, quarters burned, and a Sultanate shaken to its core.

i18n.hi: १३९८ में तैमूर की सेना दिल्ली पर टूट पड़ी। तवारीख़ों में खाली सड़कों, जली बस्तियों और हिले हुए सल्तनत का ज़िक्र है।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a dim audience hall in Delhi
panels.action: Dilavar Khan Ghuri stands among other governors and commanders in the shadowy hall of a Delhi Sultan, listening as anxious courtiers whisper of tribute, revolts, and the fear of Timur’s return.

dialogue.text: Before the storm, Dilavar Khan had ruled Malwa for Delhi. He was no newcomer from distant Ghur now, but the head of a local military lineage rooted in the plateau.

i18n.hi: तूफ़ान से पहले, दिलावर ख़ान दिल्ली की तरफ़ से मलवा का हाकिम था। दूरस्थ ग़ूर से आया नवागंतुक नहीं, बल्कि इसी पठार में जड़ें जमाए सैनिक ख़ानदान का सरदार।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Dilavar Khan’s contemplative face
panels.action: Close on Dilavar Khan’s lined, thoughtful face as he listens, eyes lowered, weighing the weakness in Delhi’s commands against the needs of his own distant province.

dialogue.text: Yahya Sirhindi would later note how, as Delhi’s hold loosened, provincial governors began to act on their own. Malwa was already watching this shift.

i18n.hi: यह्या सिरहिंदी ने बाद में लिखा कि दिल्ली की गिरफ़्त ढीली पड़ते ही सूबेदार अपने मन से चलने लगे। मलवा पहले से ही इस बदलते मिज़ाज को देख रहा था।

panels.shot: wide shot of a road leaving Delhi towards the south
panels.action: Dilavar Khan rides south with a small retinue of horsemen, leaving the scarred city behind as dust rises from their hooves and the plains open ahead toward Malwa.

dialogue.text: From the ruined capital he returned to his charge. Between Delhi’s orders and Malwa’s survival, a choice was beginning to form.

i18n.hi: उजड़ी राजधानी से लौटकर वो फिर अपने सूबे पर आया। दिल्ली के फ़रमान और मलवा की जान—इनके बीच एक चुनाव आकार लेने लगा था।

panels.shot: panoramic wide of the Malwa plateau and city of Dhar
panels.action: A sweeping view of Dhar: clustered houses, older temples and mosques, fort walls on rolling ground, with the hazy outline of the higher Mandu plateau beyond.

dialogue.text: For years, Dhar had been Malwa’s seat. Forts, shrines, and markets lay across its gentle rises, while the harsher cliffs of Mandu watched from the horizon.

i18n.hi: बरसों से धार मलवा की राजधानी रही थी। क़िलों, मज़ारों और बाज़ारों से इसकी नरम पहाड़ियाँ भरी थीं, जबकि दूर क्षितिज पर मानडू के खड़े खड़े चट्टानें पहरा देती थीं।

panels.shot: high-angle shot over the edge of Mandu’s cliffs
panels.action: Dilavar Khan stands at the edge of Mandu’s sheer escarpment, looking down at the deep valleys and forests; remnants of old Paramara walls and ruined temples cling to the plateau.

dialogue.text: Mandu—Mandavgarh—was no empty rock. Paramara builders had raised walls and temples here. The plateau held older meanings and proven strength.

i18n.hi: मानडू—मानडवगढ़—सूना पहाड़ नहीं था। परमार राजाओं ने यहाँ दीवारें और मंदिर उठाए थे। इस पठार में पुराने अर्थ और आज़माई हुई ताक़त छिपी थी।

panels.shot: medium shot among stones of old fortifications
panels.action: Dilavar Khan walks slowly beside a crumbling stone rampart, running his hand along weathered blocks, while nearby his men inspect ancient gateways and bastions.

dialogue.text: Subhash Parihar and other scholars note how Sultanate builders reused this landscape. Mandu’s rise was a layering, not a replacement, of past with present.

i18n.hi: सुबहाष परिहार और दूसरे विद्वान बताते हैं कि सल्तनत के राजगीर इस भू-दृश्य को फिर से बरतते हैं। मानडू का उभार पुराने पर नए की परत चढ़ना था, न कि उसे मिटा देना।

panels.shot: interior wide shot of a council in a fortified room in Mandu
panels.action: Inside a sturdy stone chamber, Dilavar Khan sits at the head of a small council of Malwa officers and elders as they lean over rough maps showing Dhar, Mandu, and Delhi.

dialogue.speaker: dilavar_khan_ghuri
dialogue.text: Delhi calls, but its voice is faint. Malwa must stand on its own feet.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली बुलाती है, पर आवाज़ कमज़ोर है। मलवा को अब अपने पैरों पर खड़ा होना होगा।

panels.shot: wide shot of construction activity on Mandu plateau
panels.action: On Mandu’s flat top, laborers haul stone, masons chisel blocks, and supervisors point as new walls and arcades rise amidst older ruins; Dilavar Khan watches from horseback.

dialogue.text: Between about 1401 and 1405, power shifted. Dhar faded as Mandu’s fortifications thickened, its halls expanded, its water systems renewed for a long siege if needed.

i18n.hi: लगभग १४०१ से १४०५ के बीच ताक़त का पलड़ा बदल गया। धार पीछे हटती गई, और मानडू की फ़ौजी दीवारें मोटी, दीवानख़ाने फैले, पानी के इंतज़ाम लंबे घेराव के लिए नए कर दिए गए।

panels.shot: medium shot of artisans at work on mosque arches
panels.action: Artisans carve geometric patterns on newly built arches beside repurposed temple pillars; behind them the outline of the Dilavar Khan Mosque begins to take shape.

dialogue.text: In AH 808—1405–06—the inscription of the Dilavar Khan Mosque was set in stone. It fixed his name in Mandu’s fabric, a governor now building as a sovereign.

i18n.hi: ८०८ हिजरी—१४०५–०६ में—दिलावर ख़ान मस्जिद का शिलालेख पत्थर में जड़ गया। मानडू की देह में उसका नाम दर्ज हुआ—अब हाकिम नहीं, जैसे खुद हाकिम-ए-आज़ाद।

panels.shot: close-up on Dilavar Khan Mosque inscription
panels.action: Extreme close on the carved Arabic inscription band on the mosque wall, the lines crisp and proud in the stone as Dilavar Khan stands nearby, gazing at the work.

dialogue.text: Epigraphia Indo-Moslemica preserves the verse that names him. A quiet line, but it marks Mandu’s first clear architectural claim as a capital.

i18n.hi: एपिग्राफ़िया इंडो-मॉस्लेमिका उस शेर को सँभाले हुए है जो उसका नाम लेता है। चुप सा मिसरा, पर यही मानडू का पहला साफ़ वास्तु बयान है कि अब वो राजधानी है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Friday congregation in the mosque courtyard
panels.action: A large congregation gathers in the courtyard of the new mosque: officials of Malwa, soldiers, townsmen, and scholars stand shoulder to shoulder as Dilavar Khan arrives with measured steps.

dialogue.text: From Delhi, no strong hand now reached to correct him. His khutba and coin followed local needs, and Yahya’s chronicle reflects this loosening from the center.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली से अब कोई मज़बूत हाथ उसे टोकने नहीं आता। उसकी ख़ुत्बा और सिक्का मलवा की ज़रूरतों पर चलने लगे, और यह्या की तवारीख़ इस के केंद्र से ढीले लगाव को दिखाती है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Dilavar Khan addressing officers after prayer
panels.action: After the congregation disperses, Dilavar Khan stands beneath an arcade with his officers, speaking calmly as they listen with stern faces and folded arms.

dialogue.speaker: dilavar_khan_ghuri
dialogue.text: Our duty is here—Malwa’s fields, Malwa’s towns. We will guard them as our own.

i18n.hi: हमारी ज़िम्मेदारी यहीं है—मलवा के खेत, मलवा के कस्बे। हम इन्हें अपना समझकर पहरा देंगे।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of Malwa plateau showing Mandu’s dominance
panels.action: A high aerial view shows Mandu’s fortified rim dominating the landscape; distant Dhar appears smaller below, with trade routes snaking across the plateau and converging near Mandu.

dialogue.text: Simon Digby and others see Mandu now among Delhi’s successor states: not a rebel camp, but a regional center that had learned to rule in the old capital’s silence.

i18n.hi: साइमन डिग्बी और दूसरे मानडू को अब दिल्ली के उतराधिकारी राज्यों में गिनते हैं: बाग़ी डेरा नहीं, बल्कि ऐसा सूबाई केंद्र जो पुरानी राजधानी की ख़ामोशी में राज करना सीख गया था।

panels.shot: medium shot of Dilavar Khan in an audience hall in Mandu
panels.action: Dilavar Khan sits on a modest but commanding dais in a Mandu audience hall, hearing petitions from merchants and village headmen from across Malwa’s plains.

dialogue.text: He did not yet style himself with grand imperial titles. But in tax, justice, and defense, Malwa’s decisions now began and ended in Mandu.

i18n.hi: वो अभी अपने लिए शाही लफ़्ज़ों की लम्बी फ़ेहरिस्त नहीं बाँधता था। पर लगान, इंसाफ़ और रक्षा में मलवा के फैसले अब मानडू से शुरू होकर वहीं ख़त्म होते थे।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of Dilavar Khan standing by a window overlooking the plateau
panels.action: Dilavar Khan stands by a stone window, hands clasped, gazing out at the rugged edge of the plateau as clouds drift over the ravines and farms below.

dialogue.text: Between the records there is no single date when Malwa ‘became’ a kingdom. Instead, step by step, its frontier learned to stand alone.

i18n.hi: दस्तावेज़ों के बीच कोई एक दिन नहीं जब मलवा ‘राज्य’ बन गया कहा जा सके। धीरे-धीरे क़दम दर क़दम, उसकी सरहद ने अकेले खड़े होना सीख लिया।

panels.shot: transition shot dissolving from Dilavar Khan to later Mandu palaces
panels.action: The image crossfades from Dilavar Khan’s figure to later, grander Mandu palaces and halls rising on the same plateau, suggesting the unfolding centuries of the Malwa Sultanate.

dialogue.text: Dilavar Khan would be followed by rulers with greater splendor. Yet the decision to choose Mandu as Malwa’s heart was his, carved first in cautious stone.

i18n.hi: दिलावर ख़ान के बाद राजसी शान वाले बादशाह आएँगे। पर मानडू को मलवा का दिल चुन लेने का फ़ैसला उसी का था—जो पहले सतर्क पत्थरों में उकेरा गया।

panels.shot: final wide shot of Mandu at sunset, timeless and still
panels.action: At sunset, Mandu’s cliffs glow red as the plateau’s outlines stand stark against the sky; the old mosque sits quiet among ruins and terraces, enduring above the plains.

dialogue.text: Today, standing on Mandu’s edge, we see more than ruins; we see the moment when a broken empire’s frontier found the courage to become a state.

i18n.hi: आज मानडू की धार पर खड़े होकर हम सिर्फ़ खंडहर नहीं देखते; हम उस पल को देखते हैं जब टूटी सल्तनत की सरहद ने राज्य बनने का हौसला जुटा लिया।

title_i18n.hi: दिलावर ख़ान ने पठार पर दावा किया

subtitle_i18n.en: When Delhi Fell Silent, Mandu Found Its Voice
subtitle_i18n.hi: दिल्ली सन्नाटे में डूबी, तो मानडू ने आवाज़ पाई
